Model & sources

From ocean conditions to coastal vegetation

Temperature and surface radiation→Species-specific growth models→Site histories and observations

Daily FORA–JPN60 temperature, net surface shortwave and currents cover 1998–2020. Select a polygon to inspect its linked FORA cells. Daily series retain native values, missing cells and the selected variable’s grid.

The 11 site histories are parameter-only candidate recalibrations using existing equations and forcing. Model outputs use different observables and units; species assignments to mapped habitats remain provisional.

FORA–JPN60 was developed by JMA/MRI and JAMSTEC under MEXT SENTAN, grant JPMXD0722680734. The shortwave series is net radiation at the surface; current velocities retain cm s⁻¹.
